title: Requests, People, and Body Words at R4
label: ch:pa-request-people-r4-bridge
canDo: I can retrieve old request, food, people, kin, and body-word families at long distance in small spoken and reading passes.

payoff.summary: The learner closes the moving R4 boundary with a bounded contrast among two low-tone kin words and one doubled-consonant body word, without claiming writing evidence.
